They are increasingly relevant due to the increase in usage of electric motors in current vehicles, industries, domestic appliances, and robotic platforms. As a result of the move towards brushless motors and electrification of automobiles, motor driver ICs are increasingly relevant in advanced and high-performance applications as well. Motor Driver IC Market Overview Motor Driver IC Market consists of integrated semiconductor devices that are employed for controlling brushed DC, brushless DC, stepper, servo motors, among others. Currently, brushless DC driver ICs dominate the market segment among other types of motors owing to their effectiveness, reliability, low maintenance costs, and ability to apply to many purposes. Strategic Market Outlook The emergence of wide band gap semiconductors is a big growth prospect for suppliers of motor driver ICs. The efficiency in switching and improved power density provided by SiC and GaN technologies over traditional silicon in challenging electric vehicle and industrial motor control applications make wide band gap semiconductors ideal solutions for future demands. With the adoption of higher voltage systems in vehicles and the need for energy efficiency among industrial customers, the market for these ICs will expand from its current niche. Motor Driver IC Market Regional Analysis The Asia Pacific region had the largest market share of 40.0% in 2025, dominating the Motor Driver IC market in the world, with the highest CAGR of 7.4% from 2026 to 2035. Factors driving regional dominance include concentration of electronics and automobiles production facilities, quick adoption of automation techniques, growth in manufacturing of electric vehicles, and government initiatives in building homegrown semiconductors industry. North America holds a dominant position in the market, which is driven by vehicle electrification, robotics, industrial automation, and the presence of large analog and power semiconductor vendors. The market value of the U.S. Motor Driver IC Market stood at approximately USD 1.51 Billion in 2025 and is expected to touch approximately USD 2.68 Billion by 2035, with a CAGR of approximately 5.9% from 2026 to 2035. The contribution of the U.S. in North American revenue stood at approximately 85.00% in 2025. Buy the Motor Driver IC Market Report with Competitive Analysis and 2035 Forecast: https://www.snsinsider.com/checkout/10912 Motor Driver IC Market Segment Analysis By Motor Type: Brushless DC Motor Driver IC held the largest market share of 45% in 2025, owing to their high efficiency, long life, low maintenance, and wide applicability in automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics segments. Stepper Motor Driver IC holds the highest CAGR in the forecast period owing to increasing need for precise positioning in robots, 3D printing machines, automated storage facilities, and manufacturing equipment. By Voltage Range: The 25V–48V segment dominated with a 47% share in 2025, supported by a favorable balance of power handling, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness across industrial automation, HVAC, conveyors, robotics, and electric mobility systems. 49V–240V is the fastest-growing voltage segment as industrial equipment and electric vehicle platforms increasingly require higher-power motor control and elevated voltage-handling capability. By Semiconductor Material: Silicon held a commanding position in the market, accounting for a whopping 78% market share in 2025 due to the development of well-established manufacturing technologies, cost-effectiveness, availability, and reliability for the use in motor control applications. Silicon Carbide (SiC) has emerged as the most rapidly growing segment in the industry due to the demand for high switching efficiency and reliability at temperatures above 175 degrees centigrade. By End-Use Industry: The Automotive sector led the way in terms of market share at 41% in 2025 due to increasing motor content in vehicles for steering, seating, HVAC, auxiliaries, and traction. The fastest-growing end-user sector is the Industrial Automation & Robotics sector as robotic and automated warehouse systems need precise motor control and diagnostic abilities. Motor Driver IC Market Key Trends Growing electrification of vehicles continues increasing motor count per platform, expanding demand for high-voltage traction motor driver ICs. Rising adoption of brushless DC and servo motors continues replacing traditional brushed motor designs across industrial and automotive applications. Increasing integration of silicon carbide power semiconductors continues improving efficiency in high-voltage traction inverter motor driver applications. Expanding industrial automation and robotics deployment continues driving demand for precise, intelligent motor control IC technology. Growing integration of current sensing and functional safety diagnostics continues increasing system-level differentiation among motor driver IC vendors. Competitive Landscape The Motor Driver IC Market includes major analog semiconductor manufacturers, automotive-grade power electronics suppliers, industrial semiconductor companies, and specialized motor-control IC developers serving automotive, industrial automation, robotics, consumer electronics, and smart appliance applications. Competitive differentiation is increasingly centered on power efficiency, integration, thermal performance, voltage capability, functional safety, current sensing, diagnostics, and compatibility with wide-bandgap semiconductors. In 2025, Texas Instruments introduced its DRV8214 integrated brushed DC motor driver family, featuring built-in current sensing and stall detection for automotive and industrial motor-control applications. In 2025, Infineon Technologies expanded its MOTIX motor driver IC portfolio with silicon carbide gate driver variants targeting electric vehicle traction inverter applications requiring junction temperature tolerance above 175 degrees Celsius. In 2024, Allegro MicroSystems launched its A89301 sensorless BLDC motor driver IC, designed for compact industrial automation and robotics applications requiring precise speed and torque control. The notice for the Extraordinary General Meeting, including Appendix 1: Shareholder Letter, is attached. Shareholders are encouraged to visit Genmab’s website at Genmab.com for the Extraordinary General Meeting materials, including the notice and Shareholder Letter, as well as a video message and supporting materials relating to the Company’s shareholder outreach and Board remuneration proposal. About Genmab Genmab is an international biotechnology company dedicated to improving the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases through innovative antibody medicines. For over 25 years, its passionate, innovative and collaborative team has advanced a broad range of antibody-based therapeutic formats, including bispecific antibodies, antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs), immune-modulating antibodies and other next-generation modalities. Genmab’s science powers eight approved antibody medicines, and the company is advancing a strong late-stage clinical pipeline, including wholly owned programs, with the goal of delivering transformative medicines to patients. Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
